items.title: Solana treasury earns $2.5M in staking rewards but had to sell equity to raise $12M in cash for operations
items.whyYouShouldCare: Solana's treasury generating $2.5M in staking rewards indicates strong network participation, but reliance on equity sales for cash raises concerns about operational sustainability.

items.title: Bitwise mulls tokenizing its Solana staking ETF via Superstate partnership
items.whyYouShouldCare: Bitwise's potential tokenization of its Solana staking ETF could enhance liquidity and attract institutional interest, bolstering Solana's ecosystem.

items.title: Dartmouth endowment’s crypto exposure drops by $2M amid falling prices
items.whyYouShouldCare: The Dartmouth endowment's $2M drop in crypto exposure reflects broader market pressures, which may impact investor sentiment towards Solana and its projects.
